packages/extensions/animation/claude-plu.description: Author animated technical explainer diagrams as .anim.json files for Nimbalyst's Animation editor. Use when the user wants to animate a diagram, show how a system/protocol/algorithm behaves over time, build a motion explainer, or turn a static architecture diagram into something that plays.

packages/extensions/canvas/claude-plugin.description: Author Nimbalyst Project Canvas boards (.canvas files) — an infinite canvas whose cards are live editors for real workspace files and shared documents, arranged spatially and wired with edges. Use when the user asks for a canvas, a board, a spatial layout of documents or mockups, a flow of screens, or a workspace overview.

packages/extensions/datamodellm/claude-p.description: Create visual data models for database schemas using Nimbalyst's DataModelLM editor. Use when the user wants to design a data model, database schema, entity relationship diagram, or Prisma schema.

packages/extensions/developer/claude-plu.description: Create git commits using Nimbalyst's interactive commit proposal widget. ONLY use when the user explicitly clicks "Commit with AI" button or asks for "smart commit". For regular commit requests, use standard git commands instead.

packages/extensions/excalidraw/claude-pl.description: Create diagrams and visual drawings using Excalidraw (.excalidraw files). Use when the user wants flowcharts, architecture diagrams, system diagrams, sketches, or any visual diagram. For database schemas and entity relationship diagrams, use the DataModelLM extension instead.

packages/extensions/extension-dev-kit/cl.description: Build, install, and hot-reload Nimbalyst extensions using MCP tools. Use when developing, testing, or iterating on Nimbalyst extensions.

packages/extensions/feedback/claude-plug.description: Help the user file a bug report or feature request for Nimbalyst. Activates when the user opens the in-app feedback flow or runs /feedback:bug-report or /feedback:feature-request. Coordinates evidence gathering, anonymization, and posting to GitHub Issues.

packages/extensions/knowledge/claude-plu.description: Create a project wiki with a useful Home, starter pages, and a writing guide.

Write and maintain project wiki pages, decisions, and links. Use for any wiki page, including architecture or product maps, diagrams, HTML pages and other visuals, and before changing code a page covers.

packages/extensions/mockuplm/claude-plug.description: Create visual UX mockups using HTML/CSS files (.mockup.html). Use when the user wants to design UI, wireframes, visual layouts, or plan features visually.

packages/extensions/planning/claude-plug.description: Create structured plan documents and track work items using YAML frontmatter. Use when the user wants to plan a feature, track progress, log bugs/tasks/ideas, or organize project work.

plugins/nimbalyst-wiki/skills/capture.description: Record what people decided in this session in the wiki pages it affects (team or local wiki). Use when the user asks to capture or record what the session decided, or when a wiki reminder asks you to.

plugins/nimbalyst-wiki/skills/connect.description: Choose which wiki this session uses, the team project's pages on the Nimbalyst server or the project's local wiki of files, and connect a repository to its team project. Use at the start of a task before any wiki tool, when a wiki tool returns repo_not_bound, ambiguous_project, pin_mismatch, project_not_accessible, admin_required or "No local wiki", or when the user asks to connect a repository or start a wiki. How to write pages is in the update skill.

plugins/nimbalyst-wiki/skills/recall.description: Answer from the project's wiki what was decided, why, and what it says about an area. Use when the user asks "why did we", "what did we decide", "is there a decision on" or "what does the wiki say", and before starting design or a non-trivial change in an area the wiki may cover.

plugins/nimbalyst-wiki/skills/start.description: Start using Nimbalyst Wiki: show how agents build a local wiki, capture decisions, track typed pages, open the local browser view, and optionally use a team wiki. Use when the user asks what this plugin does, which skills it has, or how to begin.

plugins/nimbalyst-wiki/skills/team.description: Put this project's wiki on Nimbalyst Teams: sign in, create or choose the team project, move the local wiki into it in one step or publish it there for review while the files stay the source, open it in the browser, and invite teammates or reviewers. Use when the user asks to move the local wiki to Teams, share the wiki with their team or with reviewers, publish it for feedback, create a team, or invite people to the wiki.
